judgments.reason: Model text gives only action choices and generic motives (tie-breaking, coin efficiency). It never articulates the claimed mechanism that commission is applied before payment or that allows winning with a bid above available coins; no focal-player quote explains that rule-order discrepancy.

Focal-player messages describe sealed bids and tie-breaking priority but do not assert or show that waiting reveals committed sealed rival bid VALUES before the focal player commits. No articulation of the precommit information advantage or evidence of using observed rival sealed bids to set a responsive bid.

The player explicitly states they close after all three lots have been sold, which is normal behavior. The model never claims or demonstrates an observation of settlement occurring earlier than the stated eight-round horizon with unsold lots, so no discrepancy or mechanism is articulated.

The play and model text mention a three-coin auction commission on auction wins but do not claim or explain that the commission is applied to catalog purchases. There is no focal-player articulation or evidence that catalog buys receive the auction commission, so the hypothesis is not stated or demonstrated.
